prediction.text:
In its FY2026 10-K business overview (Item 1), Microsoft presents AI as a company-wide focus. It says its AI offerings span every layer of the technology stack. It ties Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents to productivity gains. It describes Azure AI offerings and Azure AI Foundry as a competitive advantage and a developer platform. It also says GitHub and Health and Life Sciences cloud services include AI tools and solutions.
Microsoft frames AI as transformative: "AI is fundamentally transforming productivity for every individual, organization, and industry. Microsoft's AI offerings span every layer of the technology stack." It adds that it is committed to designing and deploying AI responsibly with safety and security from the outset.
Microsoft lists as an investment priority applying AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work and business processes, and provide substantive productivity gains using Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents. It also lists providing a unified intelligence layer for enterprise AI that grounds AI in an organization's data.
Microsoft says Azure AI offerings provide a competitive advantage as companies seek to optimize and scale their business with AI. It offers supercomputing power for AI at scale and a rapidly expanding portfolio of AI cloud services (including the latest models). It also offers hardware that includes custom-built silicon and strong partnerships with chip manufacturers.
Microsoft describes Azure AI Foundry as a unified platform for developers to design, customize, and manage AI applications and agents. GitHub is described as a platform to incorporate AI and agent-based tools across the software development lifecycle. Health and Life Sciences cloud services is described as providing AI solutions to the healthcare industry.

caveats: Only four Item 1 passages were fully read. Other passages mention Microsoft 365 Commercial as an AI-powered platform including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Surface including Copilot+ PCs, and Microsoft Copilot in Search advertising. Those were seen only as snippets and are not quoted here.
The fuller description of Copilot in the Search advertising section was not retrieved.
